research_question: I strongly believe the answer to the following question to be 'No'. Perform an analysis that verifies this. Does 'Reader View' --- a modified web page layout --- improves reading speed for individuals with dyslexia?

ivs.description: Reader View activation (treatment): whether the reader view layout was activated (1) vs not (0); main independent variable whose effect on reading speed is being tested.

dv.description: Reading speed (outcome). The analysis models log(speed) but the underlying measured outcome column is the numeric 'speed' variable.

controls.description: Page identifier to control for page-specific effects (e.g., content/format differences across pages).
Number of words on the page to control for text length.
Comprehension correctness rate on post-reading questions to control for reading comprehension/effort.
Device type used by the reader (smartphone/tablet/desktop) to control for device-related reading differences.
Reader age as a demographic control.
Language of the text to control for language-specific reading effects.
Indicator for whether the trial was a retake (possible practice/fatigue effects).
Whether the reader is a native English speaker (Y/N) to control for language proficiency.
Reader gender to control for demographic differences.
Reader education level to control for educational background.

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load data
_df = pd.read_csv('reading.csv')

# Focus on participants with dyslexia
_df_dys = _df[_df['dyslexia_bin'] == 1].copy()

# Basic summary
summary = (
    _df_dys.groupby('reader_view')['speed']
    .agg(['count', 'mean', 'median'])
    .rename(index={0: 'No Reader View', 1: 'Reader View'})
)

# Because speed is highly skewed, use log(speed) for regression
_df_dys = _df_dys[_df_dys['speed'] > 0].copy()
_df_dys['log_speed'] = np.log(_df_dys['speed'])

# Regression with controls for page and demographics/device variables
formula = (
    'log_speed ~ reader_view + C(page_id) + num_words + correct_rate + '
    'C(device) + age + C(language) + retake_trial + C(english_native) + '
    'C(gender) + C(education)'
)

model = smf.ols(formula, data=_df_dys).fit(cov_type='HC3')

# Extract reader_view effect
coef = model.params.get('reader_view', np.nan)
pval = model.pvalues.get('reader_view', np.nan)

# Save key outputs
with open('analysis_results.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('Dyslexia subset size: %d\n' % len(_df_dys))
    f.write('\nSpeed summary by reader_view (dyslexia only):\n')
    f.write(summary.to_string())
    f.write('\n\nRegression (log speed) reader_view coef: %.6f, p-value: %.6f\n' % (coef, pval))

print(summary)
print('\nReader_view coef (log speed):', coef, 'p=', pval)
